column1: # ILLUSTRATIVE ASCENT ECEF — Electron 'The Mountain God Rises' (iQPS Launch 10) — NOT OFFICIAL TELEMETRY
# Loft: Rocket Lab Electron Payload User Guide 8.0 GENERIC example flight profile (not this mission): altitude knots 0@0s

#   Rocket Lab has published NO flight timeline for The Mountain God Rises (Electron's 100th launch); mission page https://rocketlabcorp.com/missions/launches/iqps-the-mountain-god-rises/ gives 575 km LEO
# Assumptions: (a) S2-cutoff altitude set to the published 575 km orbit
#   (b) ground-relative horizontal speed ramps linearly 0 -> 7.223 km/s (circular v at 575 km minus Earth rotation along Az) at 535s.
#   Real Electron parks in a lower elliptical orbit and the Kick Stage circularizes later (timing unpublished); this file ends at S2 cutoff.
# Azimuth: mean bearing from LC-1 to space-debris area centroids HYDROPAC 3249/26 area B -40.46
#   2215Z-0700Z daily 13-26 Nov (https://www.space-notices.com/entry/launch-electron-the-mountain-god-rises-iqps-launch-10). Non-rotating i ~41.5 deg vs published 42 deg.
# Payload: 1x QPS-SAR (iQPS Launch 10). T0: Rocket Lab launch-safety page 'NET 05:30 UTC | 18:30 NZDT
#   (Fri 13 Nov 9:30 pm PST); agrees with LL2 NET (Go). Backup days 14-26 Nov NZT. https://rocketlabcorp.com/launch/launch-safety/
# Constant-azimuth rhumb Az=104.68 deg from pad. Velocity ECEF: v_horiz along Az + hdot Up in local ENU.
